FOREWO R 0
0.1 This Indian Standard (First Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 9 November 1967, after the draft finalized by the Screw Threads and Fasteners Sectional Committee had ~een approved by the Mechanical Engineering Division Council.

0.2 This standard was originally issued in 1962. This revision incorporates the decision taken by the ISO/TO 2 Bolts, Nuts and Accessories. 0.3 This standard is based on: Draft ISO Recommendation No, 940 Washers for hexagon bolts and nuts, metric aeries. International Organization for Standardization.
Doc:

ISO /TC 2 (Secretariat-184) 302 First draft proposal for washen for hexagon bolts and nuts - metric series - 42 up to and including 150 mm thread diameter. International Organization for Standardization.

Doc: ISO/TO 2 (Secretariat-194) 326 Fint draft proposal for
washers for cheese head screws - metric series - I up to and including 20 mm thread diameter. International Organization for Standardization.

DIN 125.1943 Scheiben fur Sechskantschr uben und Muttern
(Washers for hexagon bolts and nuts). Deutscher Normen-

aUlSchuss. G.t For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard i. complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2�1960�. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that, of the specified value in th~s standard.
-Rula for roUDdiDI off numerical values (rrPisttl).

III 2016 � 1967

I. SCOPE
1.1 This standard lays down the requirements for plain wash en of the following types: a) Machined washers, for precision and semi-precision grade of general purpose bolts and screws, in the diameter range 1-7 to 155 rom; b) Punched washers, type A, for black grade general purpose bolts and screws, in the diameter range I-a to 52 rom; and c) Punched washers, type B, for slotted head screws in the diameter range I-a to 22 mm,

2. MANUFACTURE
2.1 Materlal- Washen shall be made of steel, brass, aluminium or any other suitable metal specified by the purchaser,

2.2 Worlmuua.Wp - The washen shall be free from cracks. bum, pits
and other defects, The holes shall be reasonably concentric with the outer periphery. All sharp edges shall be removed,

3. DESIGNATION 3.{ A wuher shall be designated by name, type, size, number of thiI standard and material.
&tlmplls:
a) A machined washer of size 10-5 mm made of br. . shall be designated as: Machined Washer 10-5 IS : 2016-Brals b) A punched washer, Type B oCsize 14 mm made of brass shall be designated as: . Punched Washer Bl4 IS: 2016�Brau 4. DIMENSIONS 4.1 The dimensions for machined washers, punched washers, types A and B, shall be as given in Tables 1, 2 and 3-respectively ( SI' P 6 to II )_ These tables also give the size of bolt or screw for which the washen are suitable. 4.2 The other dimensional requirements for punched washers covered ill Tables 2 and 3 shall be as given in IS : 5369.1969*. t
.Gaae.l requirementa �or plaiD wuben aDd lock wuben.

4

18 I 201& � 1967

5. I'INI8B
5.1 The plain wuhen shall be supplied in natural finish unless otherwise .pecified by the purchaser. At the request of the purchaser, washers may be phosphate coated, nickel plated, tinned, galvanized, copper plated, cadmium plated, etc. The properties of the plain washers shall not, however. be impaired by the protective coating specified by the purchaser.

6. PACKING
6.1 The plain washen may be packed as recommended below: Sizes up to 10'5 mm

Sizes&om 13 to 19 mm
Sizes 21 mm and above

In boxes of 1 000 pieces In boxes of 500 pieces In boxes of 100 pieces.

The plain wuhen may allo be packed in quantities of 2 kg and 50 kg.

7. MARKING 7.1 The packages containing wuhen Ihall be marked with the aize and manufacturer'. name or trade-mark. .
7.2

ms Certification Marking
'.2.1 The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provision of

The product may also he marked with Standard Mark. Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The details of conditions under which the licence for the use of Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
